final_answer.key_evidence_summary: All 11 boutique pods are 1/1 Running with 0 restarts and no metric alerts, so pod health/scheduling/probes are excluded; Services and Endpoints are correctly bound and CheckServiceConnectivity succeeds for cartservice:7070, redis-cart:6379 and productcatalogservice:3550. Root cause: the cartservice workload carries an incorrect downstream service address environment variable.
